name: employee not created in system list
query:
SELECT
    ec.name AS "Contract ID:Link/Employee Contract:120",
    ec.first_name AS "First Name::150",
    ec.applicant_email AS "Applicant Email:Data:200",
    ec.verification_id AS "Verification ID::150",
    ec.status AS "Status::120"
FROM
    `tabEmployee Contract` ec
LEFT JOIN
    `tabEmployee` e
    ON LOWER(TRIM(e.first_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(ec.first_name))
WHERE
    e.name IS NULL
ORDER BY
    ec.creation DESC;
